name: framecore-works
description: FrameCore Works plugins for Claude Code and the Claude apps.

plugins.name: framecore-work-creative-studio
plugins.description: Creative direction and production planning for graphics, video, sound, stories, campaigns, copy, and prompts.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Browse reviewed FrameCore Works tools by task, check their installation route, and run the built-in Earshot audio capability.

plugins.name: framecore-open-assets
plugins.description: Search free media through official keyless APIs, inspect per-asset rights, and download verified files with provenance. Standalone companion from FrameCoreWorks/framecore-open-assets.

plugins.name: framemotion
plugins.description: Motion graphics from code: idea, storyboard, build, render and frame QA of finished MP4 films, standalone or as Creative Studio's motion companion.

plugins.name: framecut
plugins.description: Video editing from your footage to a finished film: analysis, transcription, cuts, captions and subtitles, mix, storyboard and render, with EDL/OTIO handoff. Works standalone or as Creative Studio's editing companion.
